purpose: Evaluate an OSC-independent confirmatory source without opening nucleotide identity or empirical genetic outcomes.

source_hierarchy.primary_candidate: GenBank/INSDC records carrying source lat_lon plus COI-family annotation
source_hierarchy.secondary_candidate: GBIF associatedSequences accession-coordinate linkage joined to GenBank/INSDC
source_hierarchy.reason: GenBank-only avoids the GBIF 100000-result search ceiling and a second-source join when source lat_lon is already present. GBIF linkage is used only if GenBank-only geometry is insufficient.

frozen_source_version.reason: A fixed full release is required for deterministic provenance.

panel_rules.species_cap_and_split: reuse the already-frozen species-name SHA256 ordering and 50/50 split semantics, but derive a new source-specific dataset digest and authorization

identity_firewall.phase_1: accession, accepted species/taxonomy, source lat_lon, locus annotation and provenance only
identity_firewall.phase_2: canonical-valid versus noncanonical/missing mask only; nucleotide letters must not persist in artifacts
identity_firewall.phase_3: source-specific exact-geometry synthetic Gate-D required; no inherited phylogatR PASS
identity_firewall.phase_4: identity may open only after a source-specific authorization receipt

gbif_contingency.allowed_only_if: a deterministic non-truncated accession-coordinate retrieval contract is frozen before row-level use
forbidden: analyst-chosen taxon partitioning after seeing eligibility
treat a GBIF-authenticated bulk download as mandatory when GenBank source lat_lon is sufficient

preflight_decision_rule.PASS_TO_IMPLEMENTATION: A deterministic GenBank-release-273 metadata-only enumeration can construct >=150 eligible non-Aves/non-Chiroptera/non-Decker species without opening sequence identity.
preflight_decision_rule.FALLBACK_TO_GBIF_LINKAGE: GenBank-only is deterministic but yields <150 eligible species and a deterministic non-truncated GBIF accession-coordinate contract is available.
preflight_decision_rule.NOT_EVALUABLE_SOURCE_FEASIBILITY: Neither route can yield >=150 eligible species without arbitrary truncation or opening nucleotide identity.

claim_boundary: This preflight does not alter the merged phylogatR method closure.
It does not claim that the direct-source arm is already qualified.
It does not permit use of Decker empirical outcomes.
It does not permit biological interpretation of source-feasibility failure.
